title: Coast Guard Medevacs Ailing Woman From Cruise Ship
description: SAN DIEGO – A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter medically evacuates a woman experiencing internal bleeding from a cruise ship nearly 300 miles south of San Diego, Dec. 6, 2013. The crew of the Carnival Miracle contacted the Joint Harbor Operation Center just before 11 p.m., Thursday, requesting a medevac for the 34-year-old American. U.S. Coast Guard video.
